venue.name: Autotalo
venue.details: Salomonkatu main entrance facing the metro station

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 25 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 24:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 25 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 24:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.name: Swedish FMC Championship 2023
items.information: Välkommen till Swedish FMC Championship 2023! Grenen 3x3x3 FMC hålls inte på [Swedish Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishChampionship2023) i år. Detta innebär att vinnaren av 3x3x3 FMC på denna tävling kommer krönas till Svensk Mästare 2023. Även om denna tävling skiljer sig mycket från en vanlig kubtävling i Sverige så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta. Det är dock extra viktigt att alla deltagare läser all information på denna sida, för att inte missa något gällande denna tävlings speciella upplägg och regler. **Notera att ytterligare tävlingslokaler kan komma att läggas till innan den 30:e april 2023.** --- Welcome to the Swedish FMC Championship 2023! The event 3x3x3 FMC is not held at the [Swedish Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishChampionship2023) this year. This means that the winner of 3x3x3 FMC at this competition will be crowned Swedish Champion 2023. Although this competition is very different from a regular speedcubing competition in Sweden, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate. However, it is especially important that all participants read all the information on this page, so as not to miss anything regarding the special structure and rules of this competition. **Please note that additional venues can be added until the 30th of April 2023.**
